caption: Alan Watts delivering an address at the University of Vermont, June 15, 1958.
alt: Black-and-white photograph of a man in academic robes speaking at a podium in front of columns, with the university seal in the foreground.
credit: University of Vermont Alumni Magazine, vol. 39 no. 1 (1958), via Wikimedia Commons
note: The journal itself is still under copyright, so no page or cover of it is used. Alan Watts contributed to this first issue of The Psychedelic Review (alongside Leary, Metzner, Weil, Heard, and Wasson); this photo, five years earlier, is the clearest public-domain portrait found of any contributor.
